messages:
Maria: FYI after the kernel-selector change I repro INF/NaN in attention with fp8/paged on a dedicated pool (p3-dedicated-us-west).

Logs:
```
step 37: softmax produced INF
attn_out: NaN in layer 11
kv_cache_write: mantissa saturation on chunk 4
```
Repro command:
```
RUN_PROFILE=1 ./serve_bench --model vicuna-paged --seq_len 2048 --batch 1 --dtype fp8 --kernel_policy auto
```
Can share selector dump and perf traces.

Jasper: saw noise in the nightly fp8 runs. Please paste the selector dump (which kernel was chosen + guard flags).

Maria: selector paste:
```
selector: seq_len=2048 batch=1 hw=A100 free_mem=28GB
candidates: flash_fused_fp8, paged_attn_fp8, flash_bf16
chosen: paged_attn_fp8 (latency_heu)
guards: softmax_stability=false clamp_eps=0
```
Looks like we dropped the stability guard for this path.

Anita: reminds me of the prior bug where guard logic skipped for batch==1. Proposal: enforce softmax_stability=true when dtype==fp8 and (seq_len>1024 || kv_paged==true).

Leo: mitigation options:
- enable log-sum-exp stable softmax in paged kernel (~+2-5% token cost)
- pre-clamp logits to a ceiling before exp
- fallback kernel to flash_bf16 for problematic runs

perf-bot: uploaded perf run https://perf.internal/runs/1919990011
notes: paged_attn_fp8 shows layer spikes layers 7-13 correlated with allocator fragmentation and large KV writes; recorded mantissa overflow counters.

Maria: quick local patch to paged path adding stable-softmax cleared NaNs, throughput -3.7% on 2048. Diff:
```
--- a/attn/paged_kernels.cu
+++ b/attn/paged_kernels.cu
@@
- softmax = exp(scores);
+ // stable softmax to avoid overflow on reduced-precision
+ max_score = reduce_max(scores);
+ scores -= max_score;
+ softmax = exp(scores);
```

Jasper: prefer toggling only when dynamic range large. Heuristic: if max-min>THRESH then use stable path.

Anita: add runtime retry: if softmax outputs NaN/INF, re-run that layer with stable-softmax once and mark kernel route as "unstable" for this model on this host for 10 minutes.

Leo: also add per-layer histogram of pre-softmax max-min to perf traces and surface to selector. Selector can learn thresholds to avoid false positives.

sre-oncall: ops note: if customers see errors, flip kernel_policy to prefer bf16 on affected pools.

Maria: I'll open a PR with three commits: 1) selector guard fix, 2) conditional stable-softmax (range check + fallback retry), 3) perf histogram metric. Assigning Jasper for perf matrix and Anita for review.

Jasper: will run regression matrix (seq_len 512/1024/2048 x batch 1..4 x dtype fp8/bf16) and post numbers tonight.

Maria: thanks everyone :pray:
